title: The Signal That Stopped Mid-Sentence—As If Interrupted
hook: A repeating signal from deep space suddenly cut off mid-transmission, as if something on the other side realized we were listening.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a message being cut off creates instant suspense — viewers need to know what interrupted it and why.

title: The Star That Flashed Like a Lighthouse—Then Vanished
hook: A star pulsed with perfect regularity for 200 days, then disappeared without a trace. Astronomers have no explanation.
why_this_can_go_viral: Stellar disappearance is rare and terrifying — it hints at unknown cosmic mechanisms or even Dyson spheres.

title: The Classified Telescope That Found a City-Sized Object Near Saturn
hook: A declassified military telescope detected a metallic, city-sized structure orbiting Saturn — and the images were immediately classified.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hidden structures in the solar system tap into conspiracy and fear of what governments know but don't share.

title: The Great Filter That Left a Graveyard of Planets
hook: Astronomers found a solar system where every planet is a burned-out husk — as if something systematically sterilized them all.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a cosmic 'sterilizer' haunting the galaxy is pure existential dread — perfect for dark curiosity.

title: The Neutron Star That Spins 700 Times a Second—And Is Slowing Down
hook: A neutron star spinning at nearly the speed of light is decelerating for no known reason — as if something is dragging on it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme physics + unexplained behavior = viral curiosity. Viewers love cosmic objects that defy known laws.

title: The Dark Matter Void That Swallowed a Galaxy Cluster
hook: A region of empty space is pulling an entire galaxy cluster apart — as if dark matter was removed from the equation entirely.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a 'missing' dark matter region implies something deliberately removed it — excellent mystery hook.

title: The Hidden Message Inside the CMB—That No One Decoded
hook: The cosmic microwave background contains an unexplained pattern that mimics a digital code. No one knows who — or what — put it there.
why_this_can_go_viral: The universe's oldest light hiding a potential message is irresistible — viewers will wonder if it's natural or artificial.

title: The Comet That Wiped Out a Civilization—And It's Coming Back
hook: A comet that triggered a worldwide cataclysm 12,000 years ago has a 2,000-year orbit. It's due back in 700 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: The return of a known killer comet is both terrifying and clickable — it bridges ancient history with future doom.

title: The Planet That Orbits Nothing—A Rogue World Approaching
hook: A rogue planet the size of Earth is drifting toward the inner solar system. It has no star, no light — only darkness.
why_this_can_go_viral: An invisible, starless planet heading our way feels like a sci-fi horror premise — and it's real.

title: The NASA File That Details a 'Second Moon'—Then Deleted It
hook: A declassified document shows NASA discovered a second, tiny moon orbiting Earth in the 1970s — then scrubbed it from records.
why_this_can_go_viral: A hidden moon taps into 'what else are they hiding?' — viral gold for conspiracy-curious viewers.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Missed Earth by 2 Degrees
hook: A gamma ray burst powerful enough to strip our atmosphere missed Earth by a hair — and we didn't know until after it passed.
why_this_can_go_viral: A near-miss extinction event triggers primal fear — viewers will share because 'we almost died and didn't know.'

title: The Dark Matter Particle That Violates Physics—And Exists
hook: A particle discovered deep underground behaves like dark matter but breaks every known law of physics. It wasn't supposed to exist.
why_this_can_go_viral: Physics-breaking particles are inherently clickable — viewers love scientific anomalies that challenge reality.

title: The Ocean on Europa That Is Boiling from Within—Right Now
hook: Jupiter's moon Europa has a subsurface ocean that is experiencing sudden, unexplained heating — as if something is cooking it alive.
why_this_can_go_viral: A suddenly heating ocean on a moon hints at volcanic activity or something worse — perfect for mystery-driven views.

title: The Asteroid That Was a Spaceship—And NASA Knew
hook: Declassified telemetry shows 'Oumuamua wasn't just an asteroid — it changed course. NASA knew, and said nothing for 2 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: The most famous interstellar object being a hidden spaceship is the ultimate conspiracy fuel — maximum shareability.

title: The Star That Erupted with Elements That Don't Exist on Earth
hook: A star in the Andromeda galaxy emitted spectral lines matching an element unknown to physics. It was never seen again.
why_this_can_go_viral: Elements that shouldn't exist challenge the periodic table — viewers love 'impossible' discoveries.

title: The Empty Patch of Sky Where Galaxies Are Being Erased
hook: A region of space spanning 1 billion light-years is going dark — galaxies inside are being 'turned off' one by one.
why_this_can_go_viral: Galaxies being systematically erased is the most terrifying cosmic concept — viewers will be glued to find out why.

title: The Great Filter That Is a Virus—And It's Everywhere
hook: A theoretical explanation for the Fermi Paradox suggests a 'cosmic pathogen' sterilizes all life it touches — and it may already be here.
why_this_can_go_viral: A cosmic virus that silences civilizations hits close to home post-pandemic — maximum dark relevance.

title: The Extinction Event That Happened Every 30 Million Years—Like Clockwork
hook: Fossil records show mass extinctions occur on a precise 30-million-year cycle. The next one is due any century now.
why_this_can_go_viral: A predictable extinction cycle makes the threat feel inevitable and imminent — viewers will anxiously share.

title: The Planet That Orbits a Dead Star—And Shouldn't Exist
hook: A Jupiter-sized planet orbits a white dwarf — a star that should have vaporized it. It's either impossibly young or impossibly lucky.
why_this_can_go_viral: Survival against cosmic odds is always viral — viewers root for the 'underdog planet.'

title: The Secret Soviet Plan to Nuke the Moon—And Why It Failed
hook: Declassified documents reveal a Soviet project to detonate a nuclear bomb on the Moon. The reason it was canceled is even scarier.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cold War space madness + hidden moon agenda = unstoppable click magnet. Viewers love secret military space programs.

title: The Dark Matter That Is Eating Earth from the Inside
hook: A new theory suggests dark matter particles are interacting with Earth's core — slowly consuming it from within. We won't notice until it's too late.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that invisible matter is eating our planet from the inside is terrifying and novel — perfect dark content.

title: The Signal That Was a Mirror of Earth's Radio—100 Years Ago
hook: A signal received from Proxima Centauri was a perfect copy of Earth's first radio broadcasts — as if it was bounced back at us.
why_this_can_go_viral: A cosmic echo of our own past broadcasts is deeply unsettling — it implies someone is listening and reflecting.

title: The Rogue Black Hole That Will Pass Through the Solar System
hook: Astronomers tracking stellar motion confirmed a rogue black hole is on a collision course with the outer solar system. It arrives in 400 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: An incoming black hole is the ultimate cosmic threat — a countdown to doom that viewers will obsess over and share.
